item.title: [6.9] AI rockets to top of worries about financial system in latest Fed survey
item.description:

Federal Reserve Vice Chair Philip Jefferson emphasized inflation as the main factor in determining monetary policy. He highlighted that economic growth and a stable labor market have been observed.
